purpose: Non-admission discovery of named global insurer and reinsurer FY2025 source filing product families that can constrain company-level synthetic portfolio calibration without assuming any confidential treaty, TIV or customer-level insured exposure.

entries.name: American International Group 2025 Form 10-K
entries.provider: American International Group / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
entries.spatial_scope: AIG North American, international commercial and personal segments
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public U.S. annual report with commercial property, casualty, financial lines and specialty underwriting segment disclosures
entries.note: Separate held/sold business, property and business interruption, casualty, cyber and gross vs net. Operating across 200+ countries through network partners cannot be equated to 200+ separately insured risk location portfolios.

entries.name: AXA 2025 Universal Registration Document and annual report
entries.spatial_scope: Global group segments and legal entities; risk location only where disclosed
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public group annual financial statements, segment/geographic reporting, reinsurance and CAT risk narratives; source figures by applicable reporting basis
entries.note: AXA consolidated IFRS disclosures are not each licensed carrier book and not property TIV. Distinguish Life/Health from P&C, entity and management segment, rate effects, and reinsurance assumptions.

entries.name: Chubb Limited 2025 Form 10-K
entries.provider: Chubb Limited / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
entries.spatial_scope: North America, Overseas General and Global Reinsurance and other reportable segments
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official SEC annual filing with P&C, agricultural, overseas, and global reinsurance segment disclosures and risk factors
entries.note: P&C written or earned premiums by business segment are not subnational physical risk locations. Reinsurance catastrophe XL only attaches after cedant deductible/attachment; a property-cat treaty notional is not assumed property TIV.

entries.name: Generali Germany 2025 solo company annual and SFCR reports
entries.spatial_scope: Germany domestic licensed insurance entities and their disclosed operations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Company-level P&C and life annual accounts plus Solvency II solo risk/financial condition reports by German regulated entity
entries.note: Do not aggregate different legally licensed carriers' premium, administrative entities and investment income as one property book. The 2025 Germany reports are separate from Generali Group global consolidated business.

entries.name: Hannover Re 2025 annual report and supplementary financial XLSX
entries.spatial_scope: Global assumed property/casualty and life/health reinsurance; operational territory where disclosed
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official annual report and financial supplement with global P&C/L&H reinsurance revenue and line/region financial breakdowns
entries.note: IFRS 17 reinsurance revenue is not automatically gross written premium or sum insured. Distinguish direct specialty insurer business, assumed treaty business, related E+S legal entity accounting links and outward retrocession.

entries.name: Munich Re Group 2025 SFCR and published catastrophe accumulation model disclosure
entries.spatial_scope: Global reinsurance, Global Specialty Insurance and ERGO direct insurance; peril-region and legal-entity scopes differ
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public group SFCR QRT, risk profile, country/nonlife group insurance and retained peril-region return-period information
entries.note: A 200-year Atlantic hurricane retained catastrophe risk metric is not underlying physical insured TIV, gross ground-up loss, or a revealed contract graph. ERGO is a primary insurance business whereas reinsurance assumes cedants' portfolios; prevent duplicate contributions in group aggregation.

entries.name: QBE Insurance Group Annual Report 2025
entries.spatial_scope: Australia Pacific, North America and International incl QBE Re and Lloyd's
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official signed report including segment GWP, net insurance revenue, product and disaster loss disclosures, and statutory vs management basis reconciliation
entries.note: QBE reporting warns management financial measures need reconciliation to statutory figures. North American crop, International reinsurance, direct P&C, financial lines and non-CAT business must not be counted as a single CAT insured asset class.

entries.name: RenaissanceRe Holdings Limited 2025 Form 10-K
entries.spatial_scope: Global property catastrophe and other property reinsurance, casualty and specialty
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public 10-K segment gross premiums and reinsurance business structure; separate property vs casualty/specialty disclosures
entries.note: 2025 property business includes cat and other property reinsurance; property segment gross premium is NOT pure CAT premium. The disclosed company business is assumed risk from cedants, not a direct asset inventory.

entries.name: SCOR SE 2025 Universal Registration Document
entries.spatial_scope: Global group reinsurance business including P&C and life/health
entries.temporal_scope: Financial year 2025; ESEF universal registration document filed 2026-03-13
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ESEF consolidated financial annual statements and segment/risk/reinsurance disclosures
entries.note: Filing announcement is an original pointer; requires fetching actual ESEF report and identifying exact tables and taxonomy. Group annual report does not reveal individual treaties, cedant assets, or insured CAT exposure.

entries.name: Suncorp Group FY2025 annual report
entries.spatial_scope: Australian general insurance group with AAMI/GIO/Shannons and other brands; entity carrier mapping requires official records
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official general insurer annual performance, personal and commercial portfolio GWP and gross/net weather-event cost reporting
entries.note: FY25 ends June 2025 and is not commensurate with calendar-year 2025 company reports without a period bridge. Brand vs legal carrier and prior sales of bank/life businesses must be reconciled.

entries.name: Swiss Re Annual Report 2025
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide P&C Re, Corporate Solutions and Life & Health Re with distinct legal and capital perimeters
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official group annual financial and risk reporting by P&C Re, Corporate Solutions, L&H Re; contains NATCAT burden and solvency disclosures
entries.note: Swiss Re P&C Re and Corporate Solutions contain different risk-bearing contracts; 2025 net catastrophe claims are not loss catalogues or source-specific event footprints. Swiss Solvency Test and IFRS 17 bases are distinct.

entries.name: Tokio Marine Holdings FY2025 group and major-subsidiary financial supplements
entries.spatial_scope: Japan, North America, International operating subsidiaries; fiscal-year and segment convention differ
entries.temporal_scope: Fiscal year 2025 ends March 2026; IR call 2026-05-20 with Jun/Aug 2026 restatements
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official FY2025 results presentation and group IFRS/major subsidiary supplemental Excel/financial summaries
entries.note: Publisher explicitly identifies subsequent June and August 2026 restatements to some IFRS performance metrics. Preserve each vintage and distinguish asset allocation/AUM from insurance exposure or TIV; FY2025 is not calendar 2025.
